europe_now.title: Ukraine civilian casualties hit highest level since May 2022
europe_now.summary: Civilian casualties in Ukraine have reached their highest level since May 2022. This is the highest recorded level of civilian casualties during the conflict.

sources.headline: Ukraine: Civilian casualties hit highest level since May 2022

top_stories.title: Ukraine grain attacks raise food price fears
top_stories.summary: Grain attacks in Ukraine have raised concerns about rising global food prices. The attacks are linked to the ongoing war.
